releases.displayName: The Skill Tree & Enemy Variety Update!

items.text: The Skill Tree & Enemy Variety Update is here, bringing new build customization options, expanded progression, new stats, and plenty of new enemies to take down!
Warning: Current Skill Tree progress will be fully refunded, allowing all players to respec from scratch. Future Skill Tree refunds will return only 90% of invested resources.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746803/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"]

Inspired by some of our favorite action RPGs, we've added a new system to increase enemy variety. Enemy packs can now spawn with special modifiers that change their stats, behavior, visuals, and rewards.
Armored – highly resistant to physical damage.
Duplicator – splits into smaller enemies upon death.
Shrapnel – releases projectiles when killed.
Anchor – slows players within its aura.
Spike – leaves behind a dangerous hazard upon death.
And more other modifiers to discover!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746803/d78fe06e9c6243047d46270078ddd48814cad836.png"]
The Skill Tree is now significantly larger than before.
We've expanded the tree with new branches, each focused on a distinct playstyle and offering more opportunities to specialize your build.
ENVY
Master elemental damage and status effects. Chain lightning between enemies, strengthen frost effects, create larger explosions, spread curses, and unlock powerful burn synergies.
GREED
Focus on economy and progression. Earn more Ash, gain more XP, improve pickups, scale faster, and grow stronger throughout a run.
PRIDE
Enhance mobility and survivability. Dash more often, move faster, recover health, and cheat death when things get dangerous.
WRATH
Pure combat power. Increase damage, attack speed, critical strikes, reload speed, and weapon range.
GLUTTONY
Become a master of the Forge. Reduce crafting costs, strengthen affixes, improve upgrade success rates, and make better use of your resources.

The Major Update: Affixes Expansion is now live! We’ve overhauled how weapon modifiers work to give you more control, more variety, and more power.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746803/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"]

Affixes now have their own rarity tiers, independent of weapon rarity. While any weapon can technically roll any affix quality, higher-tier weapons have a significantly better chance of rolling a Legendary affix.
We’ve also doubled the number of affixes in the game, with most of the new additions focused on increasing DPS.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746803/d590cc4fbbe651cb29a0bb35a0ced6734abae9b5.png"]

notes.title: If you’re still experiencing technical issues, please head to our Discord or post in the Steam Community Hub so we can investigate quickly.

items.text: [dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/SmozGpQ2Fio"]
Thank you to everyone who reported the issue and left feedback - it helped us track this down fast.
See you in the fire.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746803/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"]
Keep grinding. Keep surviving.
While we are wrapping up the playtest report and going through all the feedback, we want to highlight some of the UI changes that were already part of the last playtest.
Reorganizing menus and submenus so navigation feels quicker and more intuitive.
Adding filters and sorting options that work across all Forge screens.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746803/a076a5784340ae3ed51a9f817c2b1134e13e12e3.png"]
Implementing quick Recycle so you can concert weapons to resources without pain.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45746803/1dac139a249553ffd39bf593cd6735e83539b903.png"]
There is also a new Codex tab, a place where you can find detailed information about game entities, starting with synergies.
Settings: Standard video/audio options, plus some initial accessibility features like colorblind modes. They are not perfect yet, but definitely better than nothing.
We want you to spend less time fighting the menus and more time fighting demons.
More UI changes are coming, but the last playtest had far fewer complaints - progress.
